judgement.reason: Supabase Studio needs several separate services to run alongside it (postgres-meta, an API gateway, auth, realtime, storage and others), and Deployz cannot run that multi-service stack.

evidence.quote: Supabase is a combination of open source tools.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/docker-compose.yml defines 8 application services (studio, api-gw, auth, realtime, storage, imgproxy, functions, supavisor). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose stack runs studio alongside gateway, auth, realtime, storage and other services that the studio points to (for example SUPABASE_URL http://api-gw:8000), and the shown lines do not prove these are optional or supported datastores.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./volumes/snippets:/app/snippets:z (docker/docker-compose.yml studio), volume ./volumes/functions:/app/edge-functions:ro,z (docker/docker-compose.yml studio), volume ./volumes/storage:/var/lib/storage:z (docker/docker-compose.yml storage), volume ./volumes/storage:/var/lib/storage:z (docker/docker-compose.yml imgproxy), volume ./volumes/functions:/home/deno/functions:z (docker/docker-compose.yml functions)
reviews.reason: Studio is configured to keep snippets and edge functions in local folders backed by volumes, and nothing shown moves that data to PostgreSQL or S3.
